description: Creates a new team in a Sentry organization, requiring either a 'slug' or 'name' to define the team.

inputSchema.description: Defines the request payload for creating a new team in a Sentry organization.

name.description: Optional. The display name for the new team. If not supplied, it's auto-generated from the `slug` (if `slug` is provided). At least one of `name` or `slug` is required to create a team.
name.title: Name

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization where the new team will be created. This organization must already exist.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

slug.description: Optional. A unique, URL-friendly identifier for the new team. If not supplied, it's auto-generated from the `name` (if `name` is provided). Must adhere to the pattern: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_\-]*$`.
slug.title: Slug

inputSchema.title: CreateOrganizationTeamRequest

name: create_organization_team

CreateOrganizationTeamResponse.description: Represents the response structure returned after successfully creating a new team, containing its details.

access.description: List of permission scopes granted to the user for this team
access.title: Access

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the team was created
dateCreated.title: Date Created

externalTeams.description: List of external team integrations (only included when expand parameter includes 'externalTeams')
externalTeams.title: External Teams

flags.description: Feature flags associated with the team
flags.title: Flags

hasAccess.description: Whether the requesting user has access to the team
hasAccess.title: Has Access

isMember.description: Whether the requesting user is a member of the team
isMember.title: Is Member

isPending.description: Whether the user's team membership is pending approval
isPending.title: Is Pending

memberCount.description: Total number of members in the team
memberCount.title: Member Count

orgRole.description: The organization-level role of the requesting user
orgRole.title: Org Role

organization.description: Parent organization details (only included when expand parameter includes 'organization')
organization.title: Organization

projects.description: List of projects associated with the team (only included when expand parameter includes 'projects')
projects.title: Projects

slug.description: URL-friendly team identifier used in the interface
slug.title: Slug

teamRole.description: The role of the requesting user within the team (e.g., 'admin', 'contributor'), null if not a member
teamRole.title: Team Role

CreateOrganizationTeamResponse.title: CreateOrganizationTeamResponse

avatarUuid.description: UUID of the avatar image, null if using default letter avatar
avatarUuid.title: Avatar Uuid

TeamFlags.description: Feature flags associated with the team.

idp:provisioned.description: Whether the team was provisioned via an identity provider
idp:provisioned.title: Idp:Provisioned

TeamFlags.title: TeamFlags
